sn22.38:1.2: The Blessed One then said to the Venerable Ānanda as he was sitting to one side:
sn22.38:2.1: “If, Ānanda, they were to ask you:
sn22.38:2.2: ‘Friend Ānanda, what are the things of which an arising was discerned, a vanishing was discerned, an alteration of that which stands was discerned?
sn22.38:2.3: What are the things of which an arising will be discerned, a vanishing will be discerned, an alteration of that which stands will be discerned?
sn22.38:2.4: What are the things of which an arising is discerned, a vanishing is discerned, an alteration of that which stands is discerned?’—
sn22.38:2.5: being asked thus, Ānanda, how would you answer?”
sn22.38:2.6: “Venerable sir, if they were to ask me this,
sn22.38:2.11: ‘Friends, with form that has passed, ceased, changed,
sn22.38:2.12: an arising was discerned, a vanishing was discerned, an alteration of that which stands was discerned.
sn22.38:2.18: consciousness that has passed, ceased, changed,
sn22.38:2.19: an arising was discerned, a vanishing was discerned, an alteration of that which stands was discerned.
sn22.38:2.20: It is of these things, friends, that an arising was discerned, that a vanishing was discerned, that an alteration of that which stands was discerned.
sn22.38:3.1: “‘Friends, with form that has not been born, not become manifest,
sn22.38:3.2: an arising will be discerned, a vanishing will be discerned, an alteration of that which stands will be discerned.
sn22.38:3.8: consciousness that has not been born, not become manifest,
sn22.38:3.9: an arising will be discerned, a vanishing will be discerned, an alteration of that which stands will be discerned.
sn22.38:3.10: It is of these things, friends, that an arising will be discerned, that a vanishing will be discerned, that an alteration of that which stands will be discerned.
sn22.38:4.1: “‘Friends, with form that has been born, that has become manifest,
sn22.38:4.2: an arising is discerned, a vanishing is discerned, an alteration of that which stands is discerned.
sn22.38:4.7: consciousness that has been born, that has become manifest, an arising is discerned, a vanishing is discerned, an alteration of that which stands is discerned.
sn22.38:4.8: It is of these things, friends, that an arising is discerned, that a vanishing is discerned, that an alteration of that which stands is discerned.’
sn22.38:4.9: “Being asked thus, venerable sir, I would answer in such a way.”
sn22.38:5.2: The Buddha here repeats the entire answer of the Venerable Ānanda, concluding:
sn22.38:7.9: “Being asked thus, Ānanda, you should answer in such a way.”
